RECOMMENDATIONS NOT AVAILABLE
Recommendations for this condition are not available within CDSS. Please refer to facility guidelines or other clinical resources for recommendations.

**Minneapolis Guidance:**

## Functional or Anatomical Asplenia

## Note: Please select EACH of the recommended 4 vaccines to place orders

(Note:3 dose series-order 2nd and 3rd dose starting in 4-8 weeks in Outpt CDSS.)
(Note: 2 dose series- order 2nd dose in 8 weeks in Outpatient CDSS)

## Revaccination (booster): (Order in Outpatient CDSS)

## Repeat 1 year after completing the primary series and every 2 to 3 years thereafter:

Meningococcal B vaccine one dose

## Repeat every 5 years:

Meningococcal Oligosaccharide conj (MenACWY) one dose
